(defun c:TCT (/ pt p1 p2 ss ent entz entzz)
  (setq pt  '(0 0 0))
  (setq p1  (getpoint "\nChon diem thu nhat: "))
  (setq p2  (getcorner p1 "\nChon diem thu hai: "))
  (setq ss  (ssget "C" p1 p2))

  (command "RECTANG" p1 p2)
  (setq ent (entlast))

  (vl-cmdf "copybase" pt ss "")
  (vl-cmdf "pasteblock" pt)
  (setq entz (entlast))

  (command "XCLIP" entz "" "N" "S" ent)
  (setq entzz (entlast))

  (command "ERASE" ent "")
  (command ".MOVE" entzz "" p2 PAUSE)
)
